verdict.rationale: LibreChat documents automation-adjacent features: agents, scheduled chats, and an Agent Management API with create/update/delete. None of the evidence shows version history, review or diff workflows, or rollback for agents or automations. Plain CRUD and file-based librechat.yaml configuration (which a user could put in git themselves) are adjacent features or user-side workarounds, not first-party versioning, so they earn no credit.
